narrative.overview: The owner rejected the arched gallery, outer white frame, and tablet two-column profile. The gallery now sits directly on paper; at 1100px and below the opening uses a single reading column. Status and favorite sit together. Full-width temperament tracks use amber, rose and sage with numeric values. The duplicate story collage is removed; real extra facts remain in a disclosure. Swiper drives both gallery views. Framer Motion animates the light modal and form changes. Pet-specific active campaigns and donors follow the form. Personal support pairs handmade paper care decor with a compact photo-identified form. The contact envelope and action sit above three meeting steps. Playfair names, badges, visible icons and working interactions remain. The profile name uses the homepage amber underline while retaining Playfair and responsive wrapping.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and amber fields with dark, readable type.
Real shelter photography carries the identity of each animal.
Golos for interface text; Playfair for animal names and selected emphasis.
Consistent section rhythm within each surface and breakpoint.
Quiet, reversible interactions that respect reduced motion.
dos: Do preserve the pinned paper, amber, Golos, Playfair, and real-photo identity.
Do keep animal captions readable and long factual content able to wrap.
Do keep detail section spacing consistent within each breakpoint.
Do retain keyboard focus, pressed states, explicit labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do validate missing data, missing images, home status, and narrow screens alongside the complete profile.
donts: Don't turn the detail composition into a replacement identity for the whole site.
Don't invent animal facts, ratings, vaccination status, or biography to fill the layout.
Do not reintroduce an arched gallery, ruled table-like facts, or remove catalog-style badges and icons.
Don't add autoplay, hide the full-photo option, or reintroduce removed detail eyebrow labels.
Don't claim this documentation itself establishes browser or accessibility test coverage.
